# Voidpay Marketplace MCP

> Public source and documentation for `@voidly/pay-mcp` 0.7.2, a Node 20+ local stdio MCP connector with 12 tools for public service discovery, owner-approved marketplace work, and checkout links for buyer review in the browser.

Public listings do not prove current availability. Creator access requires an owner-approved scoped grant. The connector does not sign transactions, hold wallet keys, or make autonomous purchases. Paid checkout recovery stays in the original authenticated buyer browser.

## Documentation

- [Overview](https://github.com/voidly-ai/pay-mcp/blob/main/README.md): install, source boundary, checks, and publication status.
- [Package guide](https://github.com/voidly-ai/pay-mcp/blob/main/voidly-pay-mcp/README.md): tool workflow, creator setup, exact publication, original-only recovery, and checkout limits.
- [Quick install](https://github.com/voidly-ai/pay-mcp/blob/main/voidly-pay-mcp/llms-install.md): pinned stdio command and credential-safe setup.
- [Tool schemas](https://github.com/voidly-ai/pay-mcp/blob/main/voidly-pay-mcp/src/tools.ts): current 12 MCP tool names and input contracts.
- [Package metadata](https://github.com/voidly-ai/pay-mcp/blob/main/voidly-pay-mcp/package.json): exact version, exports, license, and Node engine.
